label: Reflexive symmetric nontransitive…: Chain enumerates left, middle and right
definition: chain enumerates left, middle and right. Every label accesses itself; left and middle access each other, as do middle and right; left and right do not access each other. The one atom p is true at left and middle and false at right. These are explicit mathematical labels, not claims about metaphysical possibilities. The evaluator reports edges and truth witnesses in this order. The separated variant keeps only the left self-edge and a separate universal middle/right component, with the same valuation; full collapse is root-relative and does not constrain that other component.
note: Stipulated mathematical experiment requested in #266, not an attribution to Hume or a metaphysical account. Historical adoption would require a separate pinned source and interpretation.
